# Pryv API Platform

> Pryv API Platform is an open-source client for a separately deployed API service. All example.com links are placeholders.

## Primary Docs

- [Full AI context](https://platform.example.com/llms-full.txt): Complete plain-text context for AI agents and documentation ingestion.
- [Platform docs](https://platform.example.com/docs): Authenticated overview for API keys, credits, and quickstart flows.
- [API reference](https://platform.example.com/docs/reference): Authenticated endpoint, auth, privacy, limits, and operations reference.
- [MCP guide](https://platform.example.com/docs/mcp): Remote Streamable HTTP MCP setup for Codex and compatible clients.
- [MPP guide](https://platform.example.com/docs/mpp): Machine-payment preview, key purchase, and Tempo streaming chat flows.

## API Surfaces

- [Chat completions](https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions): OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint with optional SSE streaming.
- [Models](https://api.example.com/v1/models): Model catalog for active API keys.
- [PII preview](https://api.example.com/v1/pii/preview): Privacy preview endpoint for text, image, and PDF redaction controls.
- [MCP server](https://mcp.example.com/mcp): Placeholder for an OAuth-backed remote MCP server.

## Agent Notes

- Use Bearer Pryv API keys only for /v1/* public API routes.
- Use wallet-signed management requests for API key, balance, ledger, and checkout operations.
- Replace all example.com origins with the deployer's configured services.
- Last updated: 2026-07-23.
